subject: Pilot quickstart: endpoints, rate targets, and provisioning checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@northbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from demo — quickstart endpoints & rate requirements

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can spin up your Hosted API evaluation sandbox within the week: 

What we covered (short):
- Pilot goal: validate user-facing recommendations generation in staging using Redwood Hosted API.
- Desired outcome: 95th pctl latency < 600ms for single-request flows, and steady-state cost below $X/token target (we'll surface an estimate).

Actions I need from you to provision the quickstart:
1) Confirm expected concurrency/peak (QPS) and typical request size (tokens in + tokens out). A quick table is fine.
2) Confirm if any data residency / VPC requirements for this pilot (you mentioned possibly moving to Private later).
3) Share a representative traffic export or CSV (we can use the sample to set rate caps and batching).

What we will do on our side:
- Provision two Hosted endpoints for the pilot: a sandbox endpoint (no hard rate limits for dev) and a production-like endpoint with a safe rate cap for initial traffic.
- Preconfigure prefix/KV caching and an optimistic batch window based on your traffic profile.
- Provide a short onboarding checklist and endpoint mapping CSV (attached: onboarding checklist + example endpoints).

Proposed timeline:
- We can provision sandbox by EOD Friday if we have the traffic CSV and token estimates.
- Production-like endpoint + formal rate cap within 48 hours after sandbox validation.

Please reply with the numbers or attach the CSV and I'll loop in Soojin (solutions engineer) to confirm the exact endpoint and cache settings.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123
From: Emma Li <emma@northbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from demo — quickstart endpoints & rate requirements

Jonas — great demo, thanks. Attaching a quick traffic export (northbridge_traffic_profile.csv) — it's a 24-hour sample from our staging environment. High level answers: 

- Typical request: ~120 tokens in, ~350 tokens out (recommendation payload includes metadata).
- Avg RPS: 8 across global users; peak RPS observed in the sample: 75 (bursting to ~90 for short spikes during promotions).
- Expected pilot concurrency: 60 concurrent sessions; expect KV cache hits ~55% for repeated prefixes (session-level).
- Compliance: US-only data for now, no EKM/HSM requirement for pilot.

We intend to start on Hosted to validate latency/cost. If things look good, we'll discuss Dedicated or Private for PCI scoped workloads later.

I've copied the traffic CSV to the Drive link as well. Please let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Li
Head of ML Engineering, Northbridge Retail
emma@northbridge.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@northbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge pilot: please provision sandbox + propose rate caps

Soojin / Marissa — Emma sent the traffic sample and confirmed Hosted for the pilot (US-only, no pilot EKM). Key numbers: avg 8 RPS, peaks ~75-90 RPS, tokens ~120/350. They expect ~60 concurrent sessions and ~55% KV cache hit.

Can you do the following?
- Provision a sandbox endpoint (rdw-northbridge-sbx) and a production-like endpoint (rdw-northbridge-pilot) under the Hosted API tenant.
- Suggested initial rate caps: start the production-like endpoint at 100 RPS with a short burst window (200 RPS for 30s) — this keeps pilot headroom while protecting other tenants.
- Configure prefix KV cache with an initial TTL of 10 minutes and optimistic batching for requests < 600ms.
- Generate the endpoints CSV (rdw_quickstart_endpoints.csv) and drop the onboarding checklist workbook (northbridge_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) with steps for warm-up, traffic replay, and tracing hooks.

Emma — we'll mark the sandbox as available once Soojin confirms. Any constraints I should pass along?

Cheers,
Jonas
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@northbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 18:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Northbridge pilot: please provision sandbox + propose rate caps

Thanks Jonas — provisioning started. Notes / recommendations based on the CSV: 

1) Endpoints and rate plan (attached rdw_quickstart_endpoints.csv):
   - rdw-northbridge-sbx (sandbox) — no explicit hard rate cap, sandbox-only keys, short retention of logs (30d).
   - rdw-northbridge-pilot (hosted) — soft limit 100 RPS, hard throttle at 220 RPS with exponential backoff guidance. Burst window: allow 200 RPS for 30s to cover promotion spikes.

2) Caching & batching:
   - Prefix/KV cache: enable session-keyed cache with 10m TTL, expected hit-rate ~50–60% given their sample.
   - Batching: enable optimistic batching for 40ms aggregation window for requests with <500 token inputs; will reduce tokens cost for high-throughput micro-bursts.

3) Warm-up & validation plan:
   - Day 0 (sandbox): run a 1-hour traffic replay from CSV at 25% scale to validate correctness and tracing.
   - Day 1 (pilot endpoint): ramp to 50% for 2 hours, then to 100% subject to latency SLO checks.

4) Observability & hooks:
   - Add trace headers to sample requests; we'll provide a short curl script in the onboarding checklist.
   - We'll preconfigure alerting for 95p latency > 650ms and token spend thresholds.

Attachments added to the Drive folder: rdw_quickstart_endpoints.csv, northbridge_onboarding_checklist.xlsx.

I'll mark the sandbox as ready once the DNS mapping completes (ETA ~45 minutes).

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
